item.name: Adamant
item.bestFor: Physical attackers that never use Special Attack
item.cardSummary: Adamant raises Attack and cuts Special Attack, the usual trade-off when a creature only hits with physical moves.

item.name: Hardy
item.bestFor: Physical attackers that can spare HP
